column1: # Cases where prosper's HLE is KNOWN to differ from the console. A mismatch not listed here fails
# test_console_oracle_replay; a listed case that now matches also fails, so fixing a gap means deleting
# its line. This is the measured backlog.
#   action  says whether the difference needs fixing. One of:
#     fix        prosper is wrong here and should be changed (no tracking issue yet)
#     keep       prosper differs on purpose and should stay as it is; the reason says why
#     triage     not decided yet: somebody has to look
#   Any of them may carry the tracking issue as a suffix, e.g. `fix:#4757` or `keep:#4757`.
#   The replay test rejects a row whose action is missing or is not one of these.
